name: Keep Accelerating spreads Accelerated Recovery to a player, not a nearer friendly NPC (#10927, #12394)
contract: Keep Accelerating 520042 reads "Your Accelerated Recovery now also applies to a nearby target." Its helper
520118 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_SPREAD_AURA, 40 yd, MaxTargets 1, trigger Accelerated Recovery 800857) carries
AttributesEx3 0x100 SPELL_ATTR3_ONLY_ON_PLAYER in Spell.dbc, as does Aeon of Resilience's bounce helper 560373.
SpreadRecovery picks the nearest valid assist target around the healed unit; it ignored the helper's player-only
attribute, so a friendly NPC, pet or guardian standing next to the healed player always took the copy.
Fixture: the Chronomancer heals itself with Accelerated Recovery 501777 (rank 7), a Stormwind-faction (12)
creature stands 3 yd away and an allied player 8 yd away. Expected: the player receives the Chronomancer's
501777 and the nearer creature never does.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Place the allied player 8 yd away
The friendly creature is nearer than the allied player
The allied player stands farther away
The Chronomancer holds its own Accelerated Recovery
The spread copy lands on the allied player
The nearer friendly creature never receives the copy
